name: blue-lift
prompt:
Make EIGHT coherent whole-character frames of blue CHRONOS, a 4-column 2-row sprite sheet on transparent background. Reference1 is the APPROVED rigid-hammer key pose set, mandatory geometry and identity. Reference2 is the EXACT canonical metal T hammer design; keep its ONE STRAIGHT shaft welded perpendicularly into CYLINDER SIDE MIDPOINT, NEVER an elbow, bend, rubber mallet, parallel offset shaft, shaft growing from an endcap, or shaft through both sides. Both armored fists close together on the SAME straight shaft on the SAME side of cylinder. Reference3 is the approved starting/carry sequence, use its ready grip/armor, but never reproduce a malformed weapon. Draw coherent COMPLETE character plus held weapon, not assembled or cutout parts. Same figure proportions/body size in all 8 cells, full closed finned black helmet with narrow cyan visor; heavy charcoal/silver armor, blue accents and circular cyan chest core. Face/torso remain toward viewer while shoulders hinge/twist naturally. Physically same fixed rigid head and haft throughout; ALL perspective changes affect the ENTIRE hammer together. Preserve barrel diameter and shaft length. Metallic black/silver flat rings and blue lightning body, round cyan inset endcaps.
Crisp detailed 16-bit pixel-art sprites, not blurry. ALL 8 have complete head/helmet/fins/hammer/boots and 30px transparent margin within their equal cells, NO clipping, no trails, shadows, particles, labels or background. Landscape 4x2 sheet. Feet at same baseline per row; model scale remains constant; bending knees can lower actual torso. Animate ONLY the eight-frame LIFT AND WINDUP, from ref3 frame0 waist-level ready to ref1 top-left maximal overhead. Fixed planted boots, heavy head lags shoulders then rises in arc. Start frame0 carrying hammer before hips, cylinder on viewer's left and straight shaft runs right to both close fists at center waist. Frame1 flex knees, frame2 lift head past left chest, frame3 lift beside left shoulder, frame4 forearms rise past visor, frame5 both hands just above forehead, frame6 near fully overhead, frame7 maximal overhead EXACTLY ref1 top-left with both fists above forehead and straight near-vertical shaft; cylinder points FORWARD IN DEPTH, near ROUND endcap facing camera with barrel receding back. Its rigid side-midpoint socket is partly occluded by near endcap, never shown as a curved elbow. Arms/fingers don't grow, helmet stays intact. One continuous sensible 3D rotation of rigid T weapon from headleft/shaftsideways to foreshortened roundendcap overhead. Draw natural hips/shoulders and articulated elbows.
